mood: A child who acts like a grown-up builds herself a friend. Then a new guard comes to the base.

hero.alt: In a dim lab a framed photo of two scientists holding a small girl stands on a desk, and beside it a white robot with rabbit ears rests on its stand, a small face on its screen.

media.alt: A man in a white lab coat and amber glasses stands at a lab bench with his hands in his pockets, a small blue vial clipped to his chest, beside a framed family photo.
A woman in a white lab coat and round glasses laughs with her eyes shut, a mug in her hand, beside the same framed photo on the bench.

inserts.caption: Chang'e's father and mother, the base's two chief scientists.

media.alt: A framed photo of two scientists holding a small girl stands on a bright lab bench as the view moves past it; a young woman with long gold hair bends down, gloved hands half raised, to a beaming pink-haired child who holds up a small white robot with rabbit ears; behind them a man and a woman in white coats watch.
